title: Make removal, reuse, and delegation selectable exits
conclusion: Reuse decisive evidence and remove redundant obligations where the required outcome survives; keep all explicitly requested strategy coverage.
applied_result: Executed a non-build route menu with rejection conditions, research/operational authority boundary, and cost of inaction.

gates.condition: A solution-independent problem, outcome measure, constraints, decision owner, and available evidence are explicit.
gates.evaluation: The problem, constraints, metric, evidence class, owner and explicit user authorization are bound in problem-brief.json.

gates.condition: The named failure test is evaluated against the unchanged problem and constraints; no rejection condition remains. Missing or inconclusive evidence preserves unresolved residue rather than selecting a winner.
gates.evaluation: The strategy failure test was applied; invalid or unsupported candidates were rejected or retained as explicit unresolved comparisons rather than forced winners.

gates.condition: This draft and any local bridge decision grant no implementation, canonical knowledge, publication, deployment, or external-effect authority. Structural validation is not effectiveness evidence.
gates.evaluation: The result claims bounded analysis and stated controlled tests only; no production adoption, efficacy, or canonical promotion is inferred.

rounds: Up to three shared critique rounds; role-round evidence reused openly across related strategies, never claimed as independent studies.
limits: No external procurement or operational delegation was performed.

owned_residue.item: Available routes in a future operating context
